how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-05-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:99156:title: ⟦E10⟧ (2/2)
rows.quest:99156:details:0: Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern ⟦E13⟧, near Venomweb Vale.
rows.quest:99156:details:1: Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.
rows.quest:99156:details:2: Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.
rows.quest:99156:details:3: See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.
rows.quest:99156:progress:0: Have you dealt with our little problem?
rows.quest:91285:title: Murlocs at the Gates
rows.quest:91285:obj:0: Slay 8 Vile Fin Attackers and 8 Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.
rows.quest:91285:details:0: Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.
rows.quest:91285:details:1: A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.
